text: Samsic is Groupe Samsic, a French services group created in 1986 by Christian Roulleau. The group's vision page says Samsic is and will remain a family-owned business. The company register lists SAMSIC (SIREN 403227796) as a SAS based in Cesson-Sévigné, whose président is Thierry Geffroy.
short: Groupe Samsic is a family-owned French services group founded in 1986 by Christian Roulleau.
